title: Campbellsville: from Andrew Campbell’s lots to a county seat
summary: Andrew Campbell was selling lots and running a gristmill and tavern by 1814, and the Kentucky legislature established Campbellsville in 1817.
bodyMarkdown:
Andrew Campbell came to south-central Kentucky from Augusta County, Virginia. The state marker says the place where [Campbellsville](https://grokipedia.com/page/Campbellsville,_Kentucky) stands was first settled about 1800 and names Adam and Andrew Campbell among the founders. By 1814 Andrew was selling town lots there and keeping a gristmill and a tavern, the two businesses that made a crossroads into a town.

A mill drew farmers who needed their corn and wheat ground. A tavern gave travelers a meal and a bed, and gave neighbors a place to trade news. Campbell laid the town out with his wife Rebecca and his brothers James, Adam, Michael, and David. The ground was then part of Green County. In 1817 the Kentucky legislature formally established Campbellsville. Andrew Campbell died two years later, in 1819.

For three decades the town was a market village in the southern part of Green County. Its people had to travel to Greensburg, the Green County seat, for court business. That changed in 1848, when the legislature cut a new county from Green. It was Kentucky's 100th county, and it was named Taylor for Gen. [Zachary Taylor](/people/#zachary-taylor), the hero of the Mexican War, who was elected president that same year.

Campbellsville became the seat of the new county. The town sold its public square to the county for one dollar so a courthouse could be built there. Court days brought farmers, lawyers, and traders into town, and Campbellsville grew into the market center of the county.

## Kentucky today

Taylor County has claimed the state's geographic center, which the city motto repeats as the city in the middle of the commonwealth. Campbellsville University, founded in 1906 as Russell Creek Academy, is part of the town today. The map pin marks the town.
Source: [Campbellsville, Kentucky (Grokipedia)](https://grokipedia.com/page/Campbellsville,_Kentucky)
